skill.name: migrate-to-factory
skill.description: Migrates user-specified skills and supporting resources into an existing Warp Factory configuration repository. Use it to adapt an agent workflow into Factory agents and skills, not for routine edits or live Factory operations.
skill.summary: Adapt an existing agent workflow into a validated Warp Factory configuration.
skill.author: warpdotdev

security_audit.summary: All ten static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, a documentation URL, or a safe scope instruction in SKILL.md. The file still requires normal review because it directs edits inside a Factory repository and handles untrusted migration sources.

remediation.issue: Migration instructions can affect multiple Factory configuration files.
remediation.suggestion: Review the proposed file changes and validate the complete Factory root before accepting the migration.

remediation.issue: Source content is treated as migration input and may contain conflicting instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Keep source repositories read-only, inspect only user-identified files, and surface ambiguous or conflicting behavior for user approval.

content.value_statement: Moving an existing agent workflow into Factory can create duplicate roles, broken paths, or conflicting handoffs. This skill guides a focused migration into an existing Factory repository and validates the resulting configuration.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the Factory root and user-provided source skill paths.
Reviews existing agents, skills, and referenced migration resources.
Maps source responsibilities to shared skills, agent-scoped skills, or new agents.
Adapts relative paths and tool-specific instructions for the Factory repository.
Preserves source repositories as read-only inputs.
Validates the completed Factory root and reports unresolved ambiguities.
limitations: It does not register, operate, or deploy a live Factory.
It does not add schedules, automations, runners, MCP declarations, secrets, or webhooks.
It depends on clear source paths, workflow ownership, and an existing Factory repository.
It does not decide ambiguous behavior conflicts without user direction.

use_cases.title: Port a team workflow
use_cases.description: Move an existing agent workflow into a Factory repository while preserving role ownership and handoff boundaries.

use_cases.title: Consolidate agent skills
use_cases.description: Review shared and role-specific guidance, then place each resource where the Factory agents can use it without duplication.

use_cases.title: Prepare a migration review
use_cases.description: Create a focused migration proposal with adapted paths, validation results, and clearly identified unresolved source behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate the skill at [source path] into the existing Factory repository at [Factory path]. First identify the workflow entry point and report any missing context.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner migration with one source skill

prompt_templates.title: Map an existing workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [source paths] and the current Factory agents. Recommend which responsibilities belong in shared skills, agent-scoped skills, or new agents before making edits.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate supporting resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate [source skill] and its referenced scripts, templates, assets, and references into [Factory path]. Keep source files read-only and adapt all relative references.

prompt_templates.title: Execute and validate a constrained migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate [workflow] into [Factory path]. Reuse existing roles where possible, preserve unrelated customization, stop on ambiguous conflicts, validate the complete Factory root, and report every changed file and unresolved limitation.

output_examples.input: Migrate the release-triage workflow from the supplied skill directory into the existing Factory repository.
output_examples.output: The workflow was assigned to the existing triage agent. Shared guidance was added under the shared skills directory, source files remained unchanged, and Factory validation passed.

output_examples.input: Move this skill and its templates into the Factory repository, but do not add new agents unless necessary.
output: The templates were kept with the migrated skill and their relative references were adapted.

output_examples.input: Review this migration for conflicting ownership before editing.
output_examples.output: The migration paused because the requested workflow overlaps with the review agent and the existing code-review handoff. User clarification is required before changes can be made.

best_practices: Confirm the Factory root, source paths, workflow entry point, and role ownership before editing.
Choose the smallest change that preserves existing responsibilities and handoffs.
Validate the complete Factory root and report changed files, validation results, and unresolved behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not copy source content blindly or execute source files during migration.
Do not create duplicate agents or conflicting handoffs when an existing role fits.
Do not add live operations, secrets, schedules, webhooks, or unrelated Factory features.

faq.question: What does this skill migrate?
faq.answer: It migrates agent workflow guidance and its referenced resources into an existing Warp Factory configuration repository.

faq.question: Does it create a new Factory?
faq.answer: No. It starts with an existing Factory repository that contains factory.yaml and default agent definitions.

faq.question: Can it add a new agent?
faq.answer: Yes, but only when an existing role cannot safely own a distinct responsibility.

faq.question: Does it modify the source repository?
faq.answer: No. Source repositories are treated as read-only migration inputs.

faq.question: What happens when ownership is unclear?
faq.answer: The migration should pause and ask a focused question before making edits.

faq.question: Does it validate the result?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses the Factory file guidance to validate the complete Factory root and reports remaining issues.
